1.ja: אמץ' אצעד מן ההנא. אנת ואלקום
1.en: 'Go, ascend from here — you and the people
whom you brought up from Egypt —

1.ja: אלי' אלבלד. אלד'י אקסמת. לאברהים ויצחק ויעקוב
1.en: to the land which I swore to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob,
1.he: אֶל-הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב

1.en: saying: To your offspring I shall give it.'

2.en: And I shall send before you an angel,
by whom I shall drive out the Canaanites and the Amorites,
and the Hittites and the Perizzites, and the Hivites and the Jebusites —

3.en: to a land flowing with milk and honey.

3.ja: לאני לא אצעד נורי פי מא בינכם
3.en: For I shall not bring up My light in your midst,
for you are a stiff-necked people,
lest I bring you to an end along the way.'

4.ja: פלמא סמע אלקום. הד'א אלכ'בר אלסו
4.en: And when the people heard this evil report,

4.ja: ולם יגעל כל אמר זייה עליה
4.en: and no one put his distinctive attire upon himself.

5.ja: פלו אני אצעדת נורי פי מא בינכם. טרפה ואחדה אפניתכם
5.en: If I were to bring up My light in your midst for even a single instant, I would bring you to an end.
And now — proceed to remove your distinctive attire,
that I may make known to you what I shall do with you.'

6.ja: פאקדאם בני אסראיל. עלי' נזע זייהם
6.en: And the sons of Israel proceeded to remove their distinctive attire,

7.en: And Moses would take the tent
and pitch it outside the camp, far from it,
and call it the tent of appointment.

7.ja: וכאן כל מן טלב עלמא מן ענד אללה. יכ'רג אלי' מצ'רב אלועיד. אלד'י כ'ארג אלעסכר
7.en: And it was that whoever sought knowledge from God would go out to the tent of appointment which was outside the camp.
7.he: וְהָיָה כָּל-מְבַקֵּשׁ יְהוָה יֵצֵא אֶל-אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה

8.ja: וכאן מוסי' אד'י כ'רג אלי' אלכ'בא
8.en: And it was, whenever Moses went out to the tent,

8.ja: יקום גמיע אלקום. וינתצבון. כל אמר ענד באב כ'באיה
8.en: all the people would rise and station themselves — each man at the door of his tent —
8.he: יָקוּמוּ כָּל-הָעָם וְנִצְּבוּ אִישׁ פֶּתַח אָהֳלוֹ

8.ja: וילתפתון ורא מוסי'. אלי' דכ'ולה אלי' אלכ'בא
8.en: and they would look after Moses, until his entry into the tent.

9.en: And it was, whenever Moses entered the tent,

9.ja: ינזל עמוד אלג'מאם. ויקף עלי' באב אלכ'בא
9.en: the pillar of cloud would descend and stand at the door of the tent;
9.he: יֵרֵד עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן וְעָמַד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל

9.en: and God would speak with Moses.

10.ja: פאד'א ראי' גמיע אלקום עמוד אלג'מאם. ואקף עלי' באב אלכ'בא
10.en: And whenever all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the door of the tent,
10.he: וְרָאָה כָל-הָעָם אֶת-עַמּוּד הֶעָנָן עֹמֵד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל

10.en: all the people would rise together,

10.ja: וסגד כל אמר עלי' באב כ'באיה
10.en: and each man would bow down at the door of his tent.

11.en: And God would speak with Moses mouth to mouth,
as a man speaks with his companion.
And he would return to the camp.

11.ja: וכאן כ'אדמה. יהושע אבן נון שאבא
11.en: And his attendant, Joshua son of Nun, a young man,
would not depart from the tent.

12.ja: אנת עאלם באנך קלת לי אצעד הולאי אלקום
12.en: 'You know that You said to me: Bring up these people —
12.he: רְאֵה אַתָּה אֹמֵר אֵלַי הַעַל אֶת-הָעָם הַזֶּה

12.ja: ואנת פלם תערפני. במן תבעת' מעי
12.en: and yet You have not made known to me whom You are sending with me.
12.he: וְאַתָּה לֹא הוֹדַעְתַּנִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר-תִּשְׁלַח עִמִּי

12.ja: ואנת פקד קלת לי אני קד שרפת אסמך
12.en: And You have said to me: I have honored your name,
and you have found favor with Me.'

13.en: And now — if I have found favor with You,
make known to me Your way,
so that I may find favor with You;
and look upon Your people, this nation.'

14.en: He said to him: 'My light shall go with you,
until I bring you to rest.'

15.ja: אן לם יסיר נורך מענא מן אלאן
15.en: 'If Your light does not go with us from now,
do not bring us up from here.'

16.en: And by what shall it now be known

16.ja: אן קד וגדת חצ'אא ענדך אנא וקומך
16.en: that I — and Your people — have found favor with You,
except by Your light going with us?

16.ja: פנבין אנא וקומך. מן גמיע אלקום. אלד'י עלי' וגה אלארץ'
16.en: So that we — I and Your people — may be set apart from all the peoples who are upon the face of the earth.'
16.he: וְנִפְלִינוּ אֲנִי וְעַמְּךָ מִכָּל-הָעָם אֲשֶׁר עַל-פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה

17.ja: הד'א אלאמר אלד'י סאלתה אצנעה איצ'א
17.en: 'This thing which you have asked — I shall do as well,
17.he: גַּם אֶת-הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ אֶעֱשֶׂה

17.en: for you have found favor with Me,
and I have honored your name.'

18.en: He said: 'Show me Your light as well.'

19.ja: קאל. אנא אמר גמיע נורי בחצ'רתך
19.en: He said: 'I shall cause all My light to pass in your presence,
and I shall call out in the name of God before you;
and I shall show kindness to whom I show kindness,
and I shall show mercy to whom I show mercy.'

20.ja: קאל. לא תטיק אן תרא נורי
20.en: He said: 'You are not able to behold My light,
for no person can behold it and live.'

21.en: 'Behold, there is a place with Me —

22.en: 'And when My light passes by you,
I shall place you in the cleft of the flint,

22.ja: וצ'ללת כבסחאבי. עליך חתי יגוז אוולה
22.en: and shall cast the shade of My cloud over you, until the first of it has passed.'

23.en: so that you may behold the latter part of My light —
but its beginnings you shall not behold.'
